doc: The helper with a = 2, b = 2.6 (the other windows of the code have this shape) on a ladder of huge and negative x, -1e9 .. 1e9, around a fine ramp: clipped to exactly 0 and 1 without overflow. Float64 closed form: rtol 1e-9. Measured: one-ulp nudges of every float input and parameter change it by at most 2.2e-15 (worst of 6 random trials); the tolerance is about 2e4x that spread.
